text:
I'm sorry your new pothos is worrying you. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress, so it isn't covered for a replacement on its own.

Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry. Keep the plant out of direct sun for the first week, and don't repot for 2-3 weeks.

If it declines significantly within your 30-day guarantee window (90 days for Leafy Plus members), you can claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). Significant decline means losing more than a third of its leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse. A Plant Care Specialist reviews claims within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. You can also chat or email a Plant Care Specialist for free care advice at any time.
